Mohammed Tariq

Senior Data Scientist | mmohammedtariq57@gmail.com | +G17702425413

Senior Data Scientist (7+ yrs) for F500 (Microsoft, Tesco), driving data modeling, BI, and analytics; led segmentation, automated dashboards, and process optimization; PG Diploma - Business Analytics (IIM Calcutta)

Freelancing (Bengaluru)	Mar 2025 – Present

Delivered diverse freelance data/AI projects while continuously upskilling in modern ML, LLMs, and MLOps (Python, SQL, PyTorch/LangChain).

Built a Python RAG PDF QCA bot (text+charts/images) using PyMuPDF, pdf2image, Tesseract/OpenCV, Sentence Transformers, FAISS/Chroma and GPT-4o to return grounded answers.

Mathco - Sr. Data Scientist (Bengaluru)	May 2022 – Nov 2024

Pricing optimization -

Deployed statistical heuristic models with Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow and transformer-based LLMs using PyTorch s Hugging Face Transformers to deliver pricing insights - boosting revenue by 40%.

Campaign Analysis & Outlier detection -

Developed a Tableau dashboard that automated data reporting, cutting down manual labor by 70% and enabling the team of 6 to focus on higher-impact strategic initiatives.

Deployed outlier detection models using XGBoost, establishing precise thresholds that flagged anomalies in ADF with over

20% fewer erroneous entries across critical reports.

Microsoft - Consultant (Bengaluru)	May 2021 – Apr 2022

Telemetry Analysis - Implemented A/B testing for new layout structures using advanced machine learning algorithms, optimizing user experience on the website while boosting user sessions by 40% and retention rates by 70%.

Tesco - Sr. Business Analyst (Bengaluru)	Jul 201G – Aug 2020

Optimization of Off Fixture Display – Worked with SQL for customer segmentation, increasing lead conversions by 60%.

Covid – 13 Analysis - Identified top-performing product categories through data analysis, driving a 40% sales increase over competitors.

Shell India Markets Pvt. Ltd - Associate Data Scientist (Chennai)	Mar 2018 – Jan 201G

Fraud Detection - Designed an Alteryx-Spotfire framework with GPU and SQL, reducing data retrieval time by 30%.

FN MathLogic Consulting Services - Analyst (Gurugram)	Jun 2017 - Mar 2018

Automated feature engineering with R using dplyr and tidyr , cutting model training time by 60%, and built an XGBoost model achieving ~0.85 AUC.

Aion Tech Solutions Ltd - Jr. Tableau Consultant (Hyderabad)	Aug 2014 – Jun 2015

Dashboard Analysis -

Designed a centralized Tableau reporting dashboard that improved data accessibility, cut resource usage by 10%, and saved 1 day per reporting cycle.

Skills

Data Science, AI s Computer Vision – Python, NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, SciPy, clustering, PyTorch, TensorFlow

Big Data, Database, Cloud s Deployment – PySpark, Databricks, SQL, Git, Azure Data Factory C DevOps

Post Graduate Diploma in Business Analytics (IIM Calcutta) - Jun 2015 to Apr 2017

PG Certification in Business Analytics (SSN SACE) - Jan 2014 to Jul 2014

Bachelor's in computer science (Velammal Engineering College) - Aug 2009 to Apr 2013
